findings.evidence: Inside.lean:160-163 — `obtain ⟨q, hqΩ, hqH, hqK⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp hin _ hΩo (image_mono inter_subset_left hp)`; the remaining two lines use only `hqΩ`, `hqH`, `hqK`, `hγ`.
findings.fix: Weaken both to `hp : p ∈ f '' U` and drop the `image_mono` step; consumers that do have a crosscut point supply `image_mono inter_subset_left hp`. Adjust the docstrings at lines 145-154 and 165-175 accordingly.
findings.issue: `hp : p ∈ f '' (U ∩ sphere ζ ρ)` is stronger than the proof needs: `hp` is consumed only as `image_mono inter_subset_left hp : p ∈ f '' U` (line 161), and nothing else in the proof mentions the crosscut position of `p`. The same too-strong hypothesis is forwarded verbatim at line 182 in `image_inter_ball_subset_filledHull_of_diam_lt`, which only passes it on.

findings.evidence: TauCeti/Topology/FilledHull.lean:133 `subset_filledHull_of_frontier_subset (hSb : IsBounded S) (hfr : frontier S ⊆ K) : S ⊆ filledHull K`; FilledHull.lean:195 `diam_le_diam_of_subset_filledHull`; DiamFrontier.lean:138 `diam_le_diam_of_frontier_subset (hV : IsBounded V) (hW : IsBounded W) (hVW : frontier V ⊆ W) : diam V ≤ diam W`. The PR itself uses exactly this composition at Inside.lean:203-210.
findings.fix: Replace the last sentence with the true relation — the frontier route is now the special case of the enclosure route obtained via `subset_filledHull_of_frontier_subset`, the enclosure route not requiring the whole frontier to be caught.
findings.issue: The module doc asserts of the filled-hull route and `TauCeti.diam_le_diam_of_frontier_subset` that "Neither implies the other". With `TauCeti.subset_filledHull_of_frontier_subset` added by this PR the filled-hull route now subsumes the frontier one: `IsBounded S`, `frontier S ⊆ K`, `IsBounded K` give `S ⊆ filledHull K` and then `diam S ≤ diam K` by the `diam_le_diam_of_subset_filledHull` added on line 195.

summary: One hypothesis is stronger than the proof uses (`p` need only lie in the image domain, not on the image crosscut), and it is forwarded unchanged to the main theorem. Separately, the new frontier-to-hull lemma makes a documented incomparability claim in Analysis/Normed/Module/FilledHull.lean false.
